description: The grove module sends a message for a service to a Grove.io channel.

parameters.name: channel_token
parameters.description: Token of the channel to post to.

parameters.name: message_content
parameters.description: Message content. The alias message has been removed in community.general 4.0.0.

parameters.name: service
parameters.description: Name of the service (displayed as the “user” in the message). Default: "ansible"

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Service URL for the web client.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: If false, SSL certificates are not validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Sends a notification to a grove.io channel
  community.general.grove:
    channel_token: 6Ph62VBBJOccmtTPZbubiPzdrhipZXtg
    service: my-app
    message: 'deployed {{ target }}'
